fileheader.author: Geunchan Kim
fileheader.note:
This model represents the BUBO Quadrotor_x aircraft.
BUBO is model name, 4 means payload 0.4 kg, s means surveilance
Aircraft Specifications: - Type: quad multi-copter - MTOW: 3.16 kg - Payload: 0.4 kg - Wing Span: 0.1 m - Wing Area: 0.001 m² - Mean Chord: 0.01 m - Cruise Speed: 10 m/s (79.2 km/h) - Endurance: 30 min - Max Altitude: 300 m
Propulsion: - 4x T-Motor MN4006 380KV brushless motors - Max thrust per motor: 2.2 kg - Total max thrust: 8.92 kg - Max power per motor: 360 W - Battery: 6S LiPo (44.4V nominal)
Motor Configuration (X-layout): - Motor 0: Front-Right (Counter-Clockwise) - Motor 1: Rear-Left (Counter-Clockwise) - Motor 2: Front-Left (Clockwise) - Motor 3: Rear-Right (Clockwise)
Motor Physical Layout: - Longitudinal spacing: 460 mm (24.18 in) - Lateral spacing: 455 mm (60.85 in)
Control: - No traditional control surfaces - Attitude control via differential thrust only
Coordinate System: - Aircraft oriented as multi-copter - Body frame: X-backward, Y-right wing, Z-up
